neighbours.label: Compact symbolic chemical equations containing element symbols, numerical subscripts, and a reaction arrow.
fire: The combustion equation is CH4 + 2 O2 -> CO2 + 2 H2O.
The synthesis can be written N2 + 3 H2 -> 2 NH3.
The decomposition is represented by 2 H2O2 -> 2 H2O + O2.
The balanced reaction is 2 Na + Cl2 -> 2 NaCl.
The worksheet shows CaCO3 -> CaO + CO2.
The oxidation is written 2 Mg + O2 -> 2 MgO.
The reduction equation is Fe2O3 + 3 CO -> 2 Fe + 3 CO2.
The neutralization reads HCl + NaOH -> NaCl + H2O.
quiet: The combustion equation is methane plus oxygen yields carbon dioxide and water.
The synthesis can be written nitrogen plus hydrogen yields ammonia.
The decomposition is represented by hydrogen peroxide yields water and oxygen.
The balanced reaction is sodium plus chlorine yields sodium chloride.
The worksheet shows calcium carbonate yields calcium oxide and carbon dioxide.
The oxidation is written magnesium plus oxygen yields magnesium oxide.
The reduction equation is iron oxide plus carbon monoxide yields iron and carbon dioxide.
The neutralization reads hydrochloric acid plus sodium hydroxide yields sodium chloride and water.

notes: Card peaks mix chemical formulas with numerical and programming expressions. A separate exploratory reaction equation fired while its prose equivalent did not. This tests a narrow chemical-notation candidate, with matched verbal equations.
